verdict.rationale: Bento documents segments as saved filters and offers a custom segment builder. It also ships an MCP server, a CLI and an API that can look up subscribers, manage tags and fields, and create broadcasts with tag-based audience rules. None of these surfaces is documented as creating or saving a segment. The plain-text AI builder claim is not tied to segments or to a programmatic surface, and tag-based broadcast targeting or subscriber filtering is only an adjacent workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
